$ azpgaad server info --query "{major: major, minor: minor, pgaadauth: pgaadauthVersion, database: database}"
exit 0
--- stdout
{
  "database": "postgres",
  "major": 18,
  "minor": 6,
  "pgaadauth": "1.13"
}

$ azpgaad server info --query currentUser -o tsv
exit 0
--- stdout
user1@example.com

$ azpgaad db list --query "[?name=='postgres']"
exit 0
--- stdout
[
  {
    "name": "postgres",
    "owner": "azure_pg_admin"
  }
]

$ azpgaad schema list --database postgres
exit 0
--- stdout
[
  {
    "name": "public",
    "owner": "azure_pg_admin"
  }
]

$ azpgaad principal list --query "length(@) > `0`"
exit 0
--- stdout
true

$ azpgaad principal list --exclude-self --exclude-names '["azpgaad_test_nobody"]' --query "[?starts_with(name, 'azpgaad_test_')]"
exit 0
--- stdout
[]

$ azpgaad role list --all --query "[?roleName=='azure_pg_admin'].{name: roleName, aad: aad}"
exit 0
--- stdout
[
  {
    "aad": null,
    "name": "azure_pg_admin"
  }
]
